implementationRules: These are coherent editable vector replacements for raster motifs, not exact pixel traces. Use them instead of extracting bitmap fragments.
Every file consists of editable SVG paths and basic shapes; no embedded images, fonts, scripts, filters, external links, or remote dependencies.
Decorative illustrations should be hidden from assistive technology in the app. Explanatory content belongs in adjacent native text.
Treat illustration as optional above 200% text size or when it competes with task content. Never hide a required control to preserve artwork.
Native OS authorization and sharing screens use system artwork and actual app branding. Do not substitute these illustrations for system components.
The Vezuna logo is separate and must use the supplied brand asset; these leaves and assistant motifs are not a logo.
